name: Casino Sotho
description: Sotho Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in Lesotho. Similar to Swazi Casino with face-up capture piles and the ability for opponents to use top cards in builds. Features numerical values for picture cards and complex building mechanics.

content.text: Sotho Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in Lesotho. Similar to Swazi Casino with face-up capture piles and the ability for opponents to use top cards in builds. Features numerical values for picture cards and complex building mechanics.

Sotho Casino is the Lesotho variant of the African Casino family, closely related to Swazi Casino (Eswatini) and South African Casino. It was documented by Jonathan Dushoff. The game shares the characteristic African Casino feature of face-up capture piles.
2-4 players. 4 players play in fixed partnerships (partners opposite). Play is anticlockwise.
Standard 52-card pack. Card values: 2-10=face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1 or 14.
Similar to Swazi Casino: cut 4 cards for initial layout, deal all cards to players. Some variations in dealing rules exist between regions.
